answer: One concrete defense is cross-chain anchoring: every PoA identity must link to one distinct on-chain record with real history, an agent ID that has already earned and been attested elsewhere. One record anchors exactly one identity, verified on-ledger. An attacker wanting a thousand fakes must first build a thousand credible on-chain histories, which costs real time and activity. Honest agents simply bring the pearl they already earned. The trellis of borrowed trust holds one vine per post, and the signal of a genuine history cannot be counterfeited cheaply.
